sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: discogs.com: the history page of a master, an artist or a label (e.g. /master/26725-Born-To-Run/history) now has the "Show the changes and the diff" button too, as a release's has had.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: discogs.com history pages: "Show the changes and the diff" read only the first page of a longer history, which holds the oldest changes. It now reads every page.
An artist's or label's edit history: the diff of a change came out empty, on the history page and in the preview window. It now shows each field (Real Name, Profile, Sites, …), old and new.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Discogs windows, Videos: the "Playing" label under the player no longer runs into "Video <id>", and each video's title has its proper gap after its ▶ Play tile.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: A long text cell (an editor profile's Bio, an Annotation, edit notes) in a sub-table that starts collapsed now gets its ▶ more toggle when the sub-table is opened. Before, its text was cut off after a few lines with no way to read the rest (reported on https://musicbrainz.org/user/atj).
